## Inactive local migration
Separate copy; schedule disabled and disconnected. All model stages use LiteLLM home-chat with separate extraction, privacy, evidence-ranking and editorial calls. All file inputs/outputs use the isolated acceptance directory. Bind dedicated IAS credentials; never activate without explicit approval. No drafting, image generation, messaging or publishing.

## Privacy-gated model evaluation workflow

Inactive evaluation copy. Run manually before enabling the schedule.

Reads only recent ".txt" files under `/data/transcripts/Krisp`.

qwen3.5 performs first-pass extraction. gpt-oss performs one final privacy, confidentiality, and duplicate-removal pass across the anonymous candidates. The final parser rejects oversized or malformed combined items and limits output to twenty themes.

The final file contains normalized hyphen bullets for downstream parsing and writes only `theme-list-model-eval-qwen35-YYYY-MM-DD.txt`.

Execute Command must be enabled with `NODES_EXCLUDE=[]`.
